items.description: Levis sits on the south shore of the St. Lawrence River, directly across from Quebec City. It is closely tied to the capital through bridges, ferries, and daily commuting.
Lethbridge is a southern Alberta city built around the Oldman River valley. It is a major regional centre and is known for the High Level Bridge.
facts: Home to the High Level Bridge
University city on the Oldman River

items.description: Red Deer is a central Alberta city between Calgary and Edmonton. It serves as a practical service and trade centre for the surrounding prairie region.
facts: Located on the Red Deer River

items.description: Medicine Hat is a southeastern Alberta city on the South Saskatchewan River. It is often associated with energy, industry, and a sunny prairie climate.
Grande Prairie is a growing city in northwestern Alberta and a key centre for the Peace region. Its economy is tied to agriculture, energy, and forestry.
facts: Service hub for the Peace region

items.description: Moncton is New Brunswick's largest city and one of the main economic centres of Atlantic Canada. It is also famous for the tidal bore on the Petitcodiac River.
Cape Breton is the main urban area on Cape Breton Island in Nova Scotia. It combines a coastal setting with a strong mining, steel, and music heritage.
facts: Connected to coal and steel history

items.description: Chilliwack lies in the eastern Fraser Valley of British Columbia, surrounded by mountains and farmland. It is known for agriculture, outdoor recreation, and river scenery.
St. Catharines is the largest city in Niagara Region and sits near the Welland Canal. Its parks, trails, and orchard country have shaped its local identity.
White Rock is a small seaside city in Metro Vancouver on Semiahmoo Bay. It is known for its long beach, pier, and relaxed waterfront feel.
Saint-Jean-sur-Richelieu lies on the Richelieu River south of Montreal. It is a river city with military links and a well-known hot-air balloon festival.
facts: Home to Royal Military College Saint-Jean

items.description: Saint-Hyacinthe sits on the Yamaska River in Quebec's Montérégie region. It is widely seen as a centre for agrifood research, education, and veterinary studies.
Granby is a city in Quebec's Eastern Townships and a regional centre along the Yamaska River. It is especially known for its zoo and nearby lake reserve.
